messages:
nora (solutions): quick sync — CobaltHealth POC cutover planning. target cutover week of 05/15 (UTC). need owners for: staging dry-run, code review CRs, network peering, cert handoff. who can own each?

liam (sales): I can own stakeholder comms and go/no-go with Cobalt. they need: 99th %-tile latency <250ms, embeddings match for 95% of test prompts, and a security signoff.

emma (se): on integrations — Cobalt will call our /v1/llm endpoint and expect streaming. we need to confirm: CORS headers, auth header format, example request/response payloads, and schema for structured outputs. cc @maya for any model-level changes.

maya (eng): no model changes planned. engineering work: (1) add streaming keepalive for 60s, (2) small routing rule for their region, (3) add acceptance-test prompts to regression suite. estimate: 3 dev-days + 1 day QA. will need CRs and code review pings at least 48h before dry-run.

oliver (infra): network ops: VPC peering + routes + firewall rules. I need the Cobalt CIDR and cert CN. peering window: we can do a 2-hour maintenance slot on 05/13 03:00-05:00 UTC. steps below:
```
- request peering from partner (they must provide ASN + CIDR)
- apply route-table entries in staging VPC
- open port 443 to their IPs (limited)
- smoke test: curl -v https://staging.redwood-inference.internal/health
```

deploy-bot: deploy triggered by @maya for branch feature/cobalt-streaming — build #782 succeeded, staging deploy at 2024-05-06T18:12:22Z.

nora (solutions): ok owners so far: stakeholder comms: liam, infra: oliver, eng lead: maya, se docs: emma. two open asks: 1) list of CR numbers for changes (maya please), 2) Cobalt CIDR + cert CN (liam please get from customer).

maya (eng): CRs created: CR-1189 (streaming), CR-1190 (routing rule), CR-1191 (test prompts). I'll add reviewers: emma, oliver. please poke when ready.

liam (sales): pinged Cobalt this morning for CIDR + cert. ETA EOD tomorrow. noted success criteria to them.

emma (se): I'll draft the integration checklist and example payloads today and drop into the repo under /docs/pocs/cobalthealth. expect a PR by EOD.

nora (solutions): nice. final checklist (please ack with :thumbsup:):
```
- owners confirmed (liam/oliver/maya/emma)
- CRs merged + reviews completed (48h before dry-run)
- infra peering done in staging (05/13 maintenance slot)
- staging dry-run (full flow) scheduled 05/14
- production cutover window (tentative) 05/16
- success metrics validated (latency, embedding accuracy, logs/audit)
```

oliver (infra): ack. will reserve peering slot and post runbook in this thread.

maya (eng): ack. I'll ping reviewers on CR-1189/1190/1191 once tests pass.

liam (sales): ack — will escalate CIDR if not received by EOD tomorrow.

emma (se): ack — PR incoming.

nora (solutions): thanks team — I'll compile a one-pager for Cobalt and share Monday. any blockers, drop them here.

oliver (infra): quick note — if Cobalt requires Mutual TLS we need cert exchange earlier. flagging now in case.

maya (eng): good call. liam, can you confirm whether mTLS is required?

liam (sales): asking them now. will update TTL.

(END)
